findings.finding: Selectors constrain each leaf independently; neither requirement prose nor a shared array index enforces same image, algorithm, claim part or source subject across bindings.
findings.counterexample: Take image subject from a valid MD5 comparison of image A; bind md5 from image B and sha1 from image C into images[0]. Separately put image A and algorithm MD5 from one comparison, acquisition hash from a SHA1 comparison of B, verification hash from another image and matches=true from any valid comparison into one acquisition_verification row. Every individual requirement is compatible, while the assembled row asserts an unproved relationship.
findings.remediation: Until row co-reference/algorithm constraints exist, use explicit needs_* declarations for the relational row fields or withhold these rows. One comparison claim proves internal equality but the projector does not require all row leaves to use it.

findings.finding: programRan.path does not constrain source to an execution log. MuiCache, dialog MRUs and Shimcache emit programRun observations. With unsupported source/time_meaning fields omitted, the retained path alone sits under an execution-log answer and loses its only caveat.
findings.counterexample: Use a valid MuiCache programRun path that has only registry-key last-write semantics, or an open/save dialog row whose path is empty. It passes path_or_application_id in every anyOf branch without establishing an execution or preserving the source interpretation.
findings.remediation: Require a reviewed execution-source subtype or keep this as a narrow observation only. Do not infer the application identifier from the empty path slot; the user-assist identifier may be in another source field.

findings.finding: The current webSearch emitter is browser.history with parsed query and history visit timestamp, so searched.query/browser/recorded_time_us are genuinely narrow source fields. Cross-field same-search association remains unenforced.
findings.counterexample: Bind keyword from history entry A, browser from entry B and timestamp from entry C to searches[0]. All pass the present requirements although the composite search never occurred. URL remains unsupported and cannot repair identity.
findings.remediation: Preserve narrow individual observations, but require same claim-part/record identity for a composite search row; if the contract is intended to admit coherent rows only, declare that relational meaning unsupported.

findings.finding: The localSearch emitter reads Explorer WordWheelQuery and records the exact text. typedInSearchBox.text is a precise matching source slot. No broader user identity or per-query onset is claimed.
findings.counterexample: The timestamp cannot be borrowed from localSearch as a per-query typing time: all retained entries share key last-write, with source-specific recency caveats. The draft already blocks that promotion.
findings.remediation: Retain keyword support and unsupported timestamp; completeness remains a separate unproved collection property.

findings.finding: host_attributes excludes backup hives and uses exact current configuration fields, so these roles are materially stronger than generic settings. Selectors still cannot restrict the record to the PC/system subject if another Windows image contributes the same role. Q3 fields can also be mixed across subjects.
findings.counterexample: In a combined evidence store with a second Windows installation, bind its os.product_name or shutdown value to the PC question. The same typed role passes; only investigator placement supplies case-subject identity.
findings.remediation: For this public case, document the current-PC subject assumption if supported fields are retained; if subject attribution must be guarded mechanically, use needs_* until subject-aware requirements exist. This is a cross-source counterexample, not an assertion about actual evidence values.

findings.rationale: extractor/filetraces.py:_shadow_copies emits shadowCopy.t from store.creation_time and shadowCopy.obj from store.copy_identifier on the same source row. These exactly support recorded creation time and copy ID, without inferring actual user action. The requirement/projector checks each binding independently, so time from one copy and ID from another can occupy one answer row. Requirement compatibility alone must not be described as proving this pair belongs together.
findings.recommended_action: Keep exact selectors. In review, explicitly state that row identity across the created_at and shadow_copy_id bindings is unproved; a same-record binding constraint would be needed to enforce coherence.

findings.rationale: All current fileDeleted producers are Recycle Bin readers: Windows $I FILETIME and legacy INFO2 deleted_us. Both represent a retained move/deletion timestamp, not secure deletion, deallocation or personally attributed action. The exact selector is appropriate for a partial Recycle Bin observation. Its existing meaning should remain expressly recorded, and arbitrary file removal/journal timestamps must not be accepted.
findings.recommended_action: Keep fileDeletedAt.recorded_time_us; add that the selected PC exhibit and common row identity are not enforced by this role.

findings.rationale: The assertion that a distinct complete original-path role is needed overlooks the existing recycle.original_path role, which is emitted from the exact full INFO2 original_path, including drive. This does not make the Windows $I stripped path adequate, and it does not make a source record exist in this case. It does allow a genuinely available typed original-path observation to satisfy the individual field without manufacturing a path or claiming complete results.

recommended_requirement.meaning: Complete original path retained in a Recycle Bin source record, including its drive where present.
recommended_requirement.evidence_needed: Exact typed recycle.original_path from the selected PC evidence. The current Windows $I reader does not emit this role, and its drive-stripped fileDeleted path must not substitute. Neither $I filename nor same-row identity with other bindings is established.

findings.recommended_action: Permit the exact typed role as a partial field if the selected source supplies it; otherwise it remains unanswered. Preserve i_filename as unsupported. Explicitly retain cross-row/source identity limitations.

question_decisions.rationale: Sticky Notes source membership and file-versus-storage modification semantics are absent from exact selectors.
Search service enabled interpretation and exact registry field/path roles are absent.
Search database classification and exclusions require a rule beyond generic path text.
DateModified column, IE/source membership and requested date scope are not fixed by generic recorded timestamps.
Search-specific message fields and date scope cannot be supplied by generic emailSent subject/address text.
Desktop/Search source scope and DateCreated column are not exposed by exact roles.
See exact supported-field and source/row identity findings. No other exact role was identified for the unsupported leaves.
Current-versus-VSS configuration/database differences need versioned source identity and comparison semantics.
Exact deleted SQLite cell/column values and VSS database identity cannot be projected from generic cloud paths/events.
OST exclusion pattern and interpretation need exact registry field roles and a rule.
See exact supported-field and source/row identity findings. No other exact role was identified for the unsupported leaves.
Actual anti-forensics on the requested day, shift-delete/wiping, tool and parameters require interpretation beyond record timestamps.
Recovery requires bytes and validation; a metadata entry recovered from a device does not establish recovered file contents.
Anti-forensic action and purpose cannot follow solely from metadata/recovery observations.
Actual PC-to-RM#2 copying requires direction and device identity; same hashes or shortcut target associations are insufficient.
Hidden bytes, original pre-rename identity, format and viewability need explicit recovery and reconstruction rules.
CD anti-forensics action/method/purpose is stronger than journal or directory observations.
Leakage-process timeline needs linked action/actor/entity and interval interpretation, beyond literal retained timestamps.
Channel-specific suspect-attributed transfers, counts, byte survival and formatting/deletion lack the necessary rules.
Diagram production, artifact format/content and evidence links have no corresponding existing claim roles.

peer_reviews.overall_decision: Retain the three narrow supported fields; explicitly disclose row-coherence and selected-exhibit limitations. Consider adding the existing exact typed recycle.original_path role as partial support; other unsupported requirements remain justified.
